author: David Gutheinz (fork maintained by lpezet)
releaseNotes: Unofficial fork of David Gutheinz's Samsung TV Remote 2.3.9.  Not published or supported by the original author.  Fork changes: (1) onPollParse() treats a 200 response with no device.PowerState field as powered on, so 2018 Tizen models are no longer reported as off.  (2) Added DIAL-based streaming app detection with the streamingApp and inMovieApp attributes, configured by the movieApps, dialPollInterval and dialPort preferences.
